decisive_items: increased CD8+ T count with inverted CD4:CD8 ratio
response.rationale: Thymoma with systemic immune dysregulation (low IgG, low B cells, inverted CD4:CD8) and oral erosive lichenoid/interface dermatitis without pathogenic antibodies fits thymoma-associated multiorgan autoimmunity; pemphigus is excluded by negative immunofluorescence/ELISA, and mycosis fungoides lacks typical skin lesions and has no thymoma link.

rejected.why: Negative indirect immunofluorescence and ELISA for pemphigus antibodies, plus lack of acantholysis, contradict PV despite oral erosions.
No cutaneous involvement, lacks Pautrier microabscesses or atypical lymphocytes, and thymoma association absent.
